world_hero_dependency_contract.hero_owned_follow_up: Audit and maintain character continuity; do not overlay duplicate character art on these full-frame cinematic shots.
world_hero_dependency_contract.lord_boundary: SHOT07 is an owner-approved trial cinematic frame. It does not create a Lord identity, Lord eligibility, Lord authority, or Lord character asset.

HERO.note: Approved set keeps the same stylized Hero presentation across movement, observation, trial, handoff, and hook beats.

SHUI.note: Approved blue Spirit presentation is consistent; Shui is near the left edge in several wide compositions and must not be used as the mobile crop anchor for every shot.

GRIK.note: Young Grik remains the same story actor across the meeting, water-route, truce, handoff, and Mist Forest hook frames.

CENTURION.note: Centurion presentation is consistent across the last-door, challenge, and fragile-truce frames; no character-art correction was made.

character_continuity_audit.VISUAL_CONTINUITY_NOTE: These are complete approved cinematic frames with embedded story characters. Journey should bind them as whole frames and must not stack a second Hero, Shui, Grik, or Centurion render over the same pixels.

shots.STORY_PURPOSE: Goblin families move deeper into the cave.

VISUAL_SLOT.SCENE: Warm cave migration passage with families moving toward the deeper chamber.
VISUAL_SLOT.CHARACTER_PLACEMENT: Hero left foreground; Shui low left/center; families and belongings move toward the right/deeper route.
VISUAL_SLOT.CAMERA: Wide eye-level establishing frame; preserve the full horizontal travel direction.
VISUAL_SLOT.LIGHTING: Warm amber cave light with a cool blue Shui accent.
VISUAL_SLOT.PALETTE: Ochre amber, cave brown, muted teal, and blue.

IPAD_PORTRAIT.RECOMMENDATION: Keep the full 16:9 frame letterboxed; a portrait cover crop cannot retain Hero, Shui, and the moving families together.

MOBILE_PORTRAIT.RECOMMENDATION: Use the full-frame contain fallback; do not crop the migration direction into a single character.
